notes: Assumptions that change the number: 1.6 kg bird gives ~65 % meat and skin (backbone and bones discarded), counted raw, so the fat that drips out on the braai is not deducted (~10 %); of the blended sauce, the reserved third is eaten in full and about half of the two-thirds used as marinade and baste stays on the bird, so 2/3 of every sauce ingredient is counted (oil 73 g of 110 g); sunflower oil taken, though olive oil gives the same energy; ~60 g juice squeezed from the grilled lemons. Sanity check: Tesco piri-piri spatchcock chicken is 185 kcal / 100 g as sold; our whole recipe is 2989 kcal over 1.6 kg of bird = 187 kcal / 100 g as sold. A serving is a quarter of a large bird (~400 g on the bone), much larger than a Nando's quarter (160–260 kcal), and homemade versions list 359–650 kcal a serving.
